mutations.name: A-length: advertise one extra UTF-8 byte
mutations.anchor:
offset = writeVarint32(out, offset, length);
      out.write(str, offset, length, 'utf-8');
mutations.replacement:
offset = writeVarint32(out, offset, length + 1);
      out.write(str, offset, length, 'utf-8');

mutations.name: A-order: put the varint value before its tag
mutations.anchor:
const offset = writeVarint32(out, 0, tag);
    writeVarint32(out, offset, value);
mutations.replacement:
const offset = writeVarint32(out, 0, value);
    writeVarint32(out, offset, tag);

mutations.name: A-empty: emit an empty embedded message
A-empty-string: omit an explicitly empty string
A-tag: reinterpret signed-overflow tags in the fast path
